records.observation: Constructor Object only. Static head length15 and half-width5; length setter unvalidated incl negative, width setter integer/2 clamped minimum1. draw compares times: strictly increasing uses forward; equality/NaN uses backward with original endpoint pairs unchanged. Both convert x, coversArrow then set full endpoint range BEFORE viewport decisions, convert rows, compute slope from unchecked int differences. Forward flags sourceX>0 and destinationX<imageWidth; backward sourceX<imageWidth and destinationX>0. Each checks only relevant side, not full viewport membership. Outside endpoint line clips/extrapolates to0 or imageWidth via Math.rint; vertical equal-x returns0 if either relevant flag fails. Vertical differing-y sets signed infinity slope; coincident pixels set NaN. Both try slope==NaN using dcmpl/ifne, which can never succeed; degenerate fallback cos=1/sin0 forward or cos=-1/sin0 backward is unreachable. NaN then fails +Infinity equality and uses cos0,sin-1 forward or cos0,sin1 backward: coincident-pixel arrowhead gets arbitrary vertical orientation. Nonvertical unit direction is +/-1/sqrt(1+slope^2), sin=slope*cos. Head base at destination minus length*unit vector, transverse half-width offsets, Math.round then long-to-int unchecked. Head drawn as three outline lines only when destination-side flag true, no fill; no explicit y clipping/entirely-outside rejection. Forward temporarily applies supplied Stroke for shaft then RESTORES before drawing head, whereas backward restores AFTER shaft AND head: optional stroke affects head differently by direction. Color remains supplied; no finally. Returns1 after calls, not proof of visible pixels. Class has no containsPixel/tolerance method; selection behavior must be established at caller or other helper, not inferred from drawn triangle. Static analysis only, actual graphics raster unverified.
